products.sourceDescription:
## Features

- Set of two
- Realistic flowers
- Indoor and outdoor use
- Hanging chains included
- Wicker baskets
- Low maintenance
- Year-round display
- Cement-filled base
- Ready to hang
- Decorative design

## Information

Add vibrant colour to your home or outdoor space with this set of two artificial hanging lisianthus flower baskets. Featuring realistic purple flowers and green foliage, they provide a natural look all year round without watering or maintenance. Each basket comes pre-filled with cement for stability and includes a metal chain and hook for easy hanging. Ideal for patios, balconies, gardens, porches, offices, restaurants and hotels.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features

- Set of two topiary trees
- Two-ball topiary design
- Decorative lavender flowers
- 70cm overall height
- Textured realistic foliage
- Cement-filled weighted pots
- Soil-effect pot finish
- Indoor and outdoor use
- No assembly required
- No watering required

## Information

Enhance your space with this set of artificial topiary plants designed to bring a natural and elegant touch to any setting. Featuring a double ball structure with detailed foliage, they offer a full and realistic appearance that suits both indoor and outdoor areas. Each plant is set in a sturdy pot filled for added stability, allowing you to place them securely without any setup required. The maintenance-free design ensures they stay looking fresh and vibrant all year round. Ideal for homes, patios, or offices, these plants provide a stylish and practical décor solution that adds greenery without the need for upkeep.
